Step:  
06-16-1507 minus 178 days.  
1507 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
Days in months before June 1507: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31.  
From Jun 16 go back:  
- Back 16 days into May: 06-16 → 05-31 is 16 days (Jun 1–16 = 16 days). 178 − 16 = 162 days left.  
- Back through May (31 days): 162 − 31 = 131 left, now at May 1 → April 30.  
- Back through April (30 days): 131 − 30 = 101 left, now at April 1 → March 31.  
- Back through March (31 days): 101 − 31 = 70 left, now at March 1 → Feb 28.  
- Back through February (28 days): 70 − 28 = 42 left, now at Feb 1 → Jan 31.  
- Back through January (31 days): 42 − 31 = 11 left, now at Jan 1 → Dec 31, 1506.  
- Back 11 days in December 1506: Dec 31 − 11 days = Dec 20, 1506.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1506-12-20
